primary_offers.title: RTX 5060 Gaming Pc Build | Ryzen 5 5600 | RTX 5060 | 16GB DDR4
primary_offers.description:
Experience next-generation gaming performance tailored for Egyptian gamers with this fully configured RTX 5060 build. Powered by the efficient AMD Ryzen 5 5600 processor and the ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5060 8GB GDDR7 OC Edition, it delivers smooth frame rates in modern titles at 1080p while supporting advanced features such as DLSS 4 and ray tracing. The system is completed by dual-channel 16GB Kingston DDR4 memory, a fast 256GB NVMe SSD, the ASUS PRIME B550M-A WIFI II motherboard, and an Antec ARGB case with integrated 650W power supply for a balanced, ready-to-play setup.


Key Features


AMD Ryzen 5 5600 (6 cores / 12 threads, up to 4.4 GHz) - Delivers strong multi-threaded performance for gaming, streaming, and light productivity with excellent efficiency.

ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5060 8GB GDDR7 OC Edition - Provides elevated 1080p frame rates with DLSS 4, Frame Generation, and efficient dual-fan cooling for sustained sessions.

Kingston 16GB (2×8GB) DDR4 3200 MHz + 256GB NVMe storage - Enables smooth dual-channel multitasking, faster game loading, and responsive system performance.

Antec AX65 case with 4× 120 mm ARGB fans + Atom V650 PSU - Offers excellent airflow, vibrant lighting, and stable power delivery for quiet, reliable long-term operation.



KEY SPECIFICATIONS




Component
Specification




CPU
AMD Ryzen 5 5600 (6 Cores / 12 Threads, 3.5 GHz base / up to 4.4 GHz boost, 65 W)


GPU
ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 5060 8GB GDDR7 OC Edition (Blackwell, DLSS 4)


RAM
Kingston 16GB (2×8GB) DDR4 3200 MHz CL22


Storage
HIKSEMI Wave 256GB NVMe M.2 SSD


Motherboard
ASUS PRIME B550M-A WIFI II (B550 chipset, Wi-Fi, mATX)


PSU
Antec Atom V650 (650 W)


Cooling
Stock CPU cooler + Case fans


Case
Antec AX65 (4× 120 mm ARGB fans)




* Components may vary slightly depending on availability and region.


Performance Excellence
This configuration is optimized for high-frame-rate 1080p gaming in competitive and modern titles, leveraging the RTX 5060’s architecture and DLSS 4 for elevated performance and visual fidelity. The Ryzen 5 5600 pairs efficiently with the GPU and dual-channel 16GB DDR4 memory to minimize bottlenecks in the majority of contemporary games, while the NVMe storage accelerates load times. Realistic expectations place it as a strong mid-range option for smooth gameplay at Full HD resolutions with headroom for esports and many AAA titles at high settings.


User Experience & Comfort
The system prioritizes quiet and efficient operation through the Antec case’s multi-fan ARGB cooling design and the low-TDP Ryzen 5 5600. Dual-channel memory ensures smoother multitasking, while the B550 platform leaves clear upgrade paths for additional storage or higher-capacity RAM. Reliable power delivery from the 650 W unit supports stable performance, and the compact mATX layout simplifies future maintenance. Overall, it offers a dependable, ready-to-use platform suited to everyday gaming and light multitasking.


Design & Build Quality
The Antec AX65 chassis features a modern aesthetic with four pre-installed 120 mm ARGB fans that deliver strong airflow while showcasing customizable lighting. Durable construction and an efficient internal layout promote thermal management and component longevity. The ASUS Dual GPU cooler maintains low temperatures under load, contributing to a polished, gamer-oriented appearance without excessive noise.


Connectivity & Compatibility

Integrated Wi-Fi on the ASUS PRIME B550M-A WIFI II motherboard for convenient wireless networking.
PCIe 4.0 support, multiple USB ports, and HDMI/DisplayPort outputs on the RTX 5060 for multi-monitor setups.
AM4 platform with expansion slots for additional storage and memory upgrades (supports higher dual-channel DDR4 configurations).



Perfect For

1080p high-refresh-rate gaming and esports titles.
Casual AAA gaming with DLSS support and light content creation or streaming.
Value-oriented next-generation entry builds for the Egyptian market.



Why Choose This Build/Bundle
This RTX 5060 gaming PC build delivers a carefully balanced combination of proven AMD Zen 3 efficiency and NVIDIA’s latest mid-range graphics capabilities at a competitive price point for Egypt. Dual-channel 16GB DDR4 memory improves responsiveness over single-stick configurations, while the mature B550 platform provides clear upgrade flexibility. Reliable Antec power and cooling ensure long-term stability, making it an intelligent choice for gamers seeking strong price-to-performance without unnecessary excess.


Frequently Asked Questions


Q: Can I upgrade the RAM or storage later?
A: Yes. The B550 motherboard supports dual-channel DDR4 configurations up to higher capacities and additional M.2 or SATA storage devices.

Q: Is this suitable for 1440p gaming?
A: The RTX 5060 with DLSS 4 delivers playable 1440p performance in many titles; however, the primary strength of this build remains optimized 1080p high-frame-rate gaming.

Q: What warranty and compatibility can I expect?
A: All components carry manufacturer warranties. The system is fully compatible with Windows 11 and standard gaming peripherals; local Egyptian support channels apply depending on the seller.
